@@ -0,0 +1,120 @@
+# GNU General Public License v3.0+ (see COPYING or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
+
+import os
+import threading
+from queue import Queue
+from unittest.mock import MagicMock, Mock
+
+import pytest
+
+from ansible.executor.task_queue_manager import DisplaySend, FinalQueue
+from ansible.plugins.strategy import StrategyBase, _sentinel, results_thread_main
+from ansible.utils.display import Display
+from ansible.utils.multiprocessing import context as multiprocessing_context
+
+
+def _display_in_fork(queue):
+    display = Display()
+    display.set_queue(queue)
+    display.display('from worker', stderr=True)
+
+
+def test_display_queue_is_restricted_to_forks(monkeypatch):
+    display = Display()
+    queue = Mock()
+    lock = MagicMock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(display, '_lock', lock)
+    child_pid = os.getpid() + 1
+
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
+        display.set_queue(queue)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr('ansible.utils.display.os.getpid', lambda: child_pid)
+    try:
+        display.set_queue(queue)
+        display.display('message', color='blue', stderr=True, screen_only=True,
+                        log_only=True, newline=False)
+        queue.send_display.assert_called_once_with(
+            'message', color='blue', stderr=True, screen_only=True,
+            log_only=True, newline=False,
+        )
+        lock.__enter__.assert_not_called()
+    finally:
+        display._final_q = None
+
+
+def test_parent_display_acquires_lock(monkeypatch):
+    display = Display()
+    lock = MagicMock()
+    write = Mock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(display, '_lock', lock)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(display, '_display', write)
+
+    display.display('message')
+
+    lock.__enter__.assert_called_once_with()
+    write.assert_called_once_with('message', color=None, stderr=False,
+                                  screen_only=False, log_only=False, newline=True)
+
+
+def test_final_queue_sends_display_event():
+    queue = FinalQueue()
+    try:
+        queue.send_display('message', stderr=True, newline=False)
+        event = queue.get(timeout=5)
+        assert isinstance(event, DisplaySend)
+        assert event.args == ('message',)
+        assert event.kwargs == {'stderr': True, 'newline': False}
+    finally:
+        queue.close()
+        queue.join_thread()
+
+
+def test_forked_display_is_sent_to_parent():
+    queue = FinalQueue()
+    worker = multiprocessing_context.Process(target=_display_in_fork, args=(queue,))
+    try:
+        worker.start()
+        event = queue.get(timeout=5)
+        worker.join(timeout=5)
+        assert worker.exitcode == 0
+        assert isinstance(event, DisplaySend)
+        assert event.args == ('from worker',)
+        assert event.kwargs['stderr'] is True
+    finally:
+        if worker.is_alive():
+            worker.terminate()
+            worker.join()
+        queue.close()
+        queue.join_thread()
+
+
+def test_results_thread_replays_all_display_events(monkeypatch):
+    queue = Queue()
+    queue.put(DisplaySend('first', stderr=True))
+    queue.put(DisplaySend('second', newline=False))
+    queue.put(_sentinel)
+    strategy = Mock(_final_q=queue)
+    display = Mock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr('ansible.plugins.strategy.display', display)
+
+    results_thread_main(strategy)
+
+    assert display.display.call_count == 2
+    display.display.assert_any_call('first', stderr=True)
+    display.display.assert_any_call('second', newline=False)
+
+
+def test_strategy_cleanup_drains_worker_display_before_stopping_reader(monkeypatch):
+    queue = Queue()
+    strategy = Mock(_final_q=queue, _active_connections={})
+    strategy._tqm._cleanup_processes.side_effect = lambda: queue.put(DisplaySend('last'))
+    strategy._results_thread = threading.Thread(target=results_thread_main, args=(strategy,))
+    display = Mock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr('ansible.plugins.strategy.display', display)
+
+    strategy._results_thread.start()
+    StrategyBase.cleanup(strategy)
+
+    display.display.assert_called_once_with('last')
+    assert not strategy._results_thread.is_alive()
